text:
alex: Hey all — need quick approval path for a Stratatech POC. They're asking for 25% off hosted API for a 3-month POC. Usage estimate: ~2M tokens/month during POC, with potential to convert to Dedicated and a 24mo commit afterwards. Can we do 25% for the POC only? cc @maria

maria: A few q's — Is this 25% off list or off negotiated partner rate? Do they commit to any minimum spend after POC? Typically we do 10-15% for short POCs, or deeper discounts with a commit.

alex: It was requested off list. No post-POC commit in the initial ask, but they signalled interest in converting if latency/costs look good.

blake: 25% is pretty deep for hosted. Need expected ACV if they convert. What's the baseline $/month?

alex: Baseline list cost estimate for hosted at their usage is ~$18k/month during POC. If they convert to prod (Dedicated), could be ~180k/yr ARR at scale (ballpark).

pricing-bot: Pricing bands: 0-10% = auto approve; 11-20% = require Deal Desk review; >20% = VP approval required. See https://redwood.internal/pricing-bands

ops-dealdesk: @alex please open the Deal Desk form and add projected ARR + SOW. We need committed spend numbers to evaluate concession. Link: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/new (add label EDGEFLUX-1923)

sam: Legal note — for hosted POCs we require a DPA and minimal data retention terms. If conversion goes Dedicated and they need SOC2 in the contract, that's a separate checklist. No major legal blocker for the POC discount itself.

maria: Suggestion: Offer 18% off the hosted list for the 3-month POC conditioned on a convert-or-pay milestone: if they don't convert within 90 days, they pay a one-time uplift to bring effective discount to 10% for the POC usage. Or: 15% off for POC + 12mo commit at 15% for prod. Which option better protects margin?

blake: I can approve up to 18% for POC if we get a written commitment to discuss conversion and a named sponsor. Anything >18% needs my sign-off + pricing-ops.

alex: They can commit to a technical conversion review and exec sponsor but won't sign a 24mo today. I'd prefer option: 18% POC + conversion path to 12mo at 15%.

ops-dealdesk: Noted. Please file the deal desk request with the exact SOW and the conditional conversion clause. Ticket #DD-2026 created. Attach the SOW and a short rationale (customer logo, strategic value, risk of churn).

pricing-bot: For reference, applying 18% discount yields POC monthly billed = $14760 (from $18,000). If they convert to 12mo at 15% on projected $15k/mo that preserves ~acceptable margin.

maria: OK — I'll draft a short SOW and the conditional conversion clause. Alex, can you get the exec sponsor name and confirm timeline?

alex: Yes — I'll loop in their VP of Data, Teresa, and get a firm timeline. Will submit DD form + SOW today. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

blake: Good. If Deal Desk + Pricing Ops sign off on DD-2026, proceed. Keep me in the loop before signatures.

ops-dealdesk: Closing note: any concession >20% will require VP written approval and Finance sign-off. Current plan within thresholds.

alex: Will do — sending updated SOW in channel when submitted.
